subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers require real embedded-agent proof and choose this stale-internal-drop strategy before merging this PR, given the competing open preserve-as-context candidate at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The code path changes session-state repair semantics and the current contributor proof is test-only, while another proof-positive open PR fixes the same canonical issue with different prompt/session behavior.

options.title: Require proof and choose semantics first
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until redacted real embedded-agent proof is added and maintainers explicitly accept the six-source stale-internal-drop scope.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime proof for both the internal-drop and sessions_send-preserve paths and are willing to own the predicate scope.

options.title: Pause in favor of broader repair
options.body: If maintainers prefer preserve-as-context semantics, pause or close this PR only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 becomes the chosen landing path.

recommendation.title: Require proof and choose semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until redacted real embedded-agent proof is added and maintainers explicitly accept the six-source stale-internal-drop scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the agent runtime internalization and is the best available routing candidate for choosing the embedded-runner/session-state semantics.
